I'm afraid this has all been a terrible misunderstanding.''"
"''One that you're going to answer for. Now drop your weapons.|Ketsu Onyo and the stormtrooper sergeant|}} A '''stormtrooper sergeant''' operated on the [[planet]] [[Garel]] during the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]]. While patrolling locked down [[hangar]]s in the [[Garel City Spaceport]], the [[sergeant]] and his squad of [[stormtrooper]]s came across the [[bounty hunter]] [[Ketsu Onyo]] and her old partner [[Sabine Wren]] while they were in the middle of a standoff. When the [[Stormtrooper Commander|stormtrooper commanding officer]] ordered them and their [[Ezra Bridger|other]] [[EG-86|companions]] to disperse, Onyo [[Skirmish in the Garel City Spaceport|opened fire]] on the [[trooper]]s. After several of the sergeant's men were incapacitated, the [[commanding officer]] tried to fight Onyo in single combat after she disarmed him, but the [[Imperial officer|officer]] was defeated. After Onyo and the others departed the hangar, the sergeant returned to his [[Limb|feet]] and expressed a dislike for the bounty hunters on Garel. ==Biography== {{Quote|There's a curfew on this hangar—you need to leave immediately!|The stormtrooper sergeant|}} [[File:Blood_Sisters_ep_guide.png|thumb|left|230px|The sergeant and his men fight the rebels]] A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] individual served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]] as a [[stormtrooper]] [[sergeant]]The [[canon]] source book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' notes that [[stormtrooper]]s wearing [[Color|white]] [[pauldron]]s carry the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[sergeant]]. on the [[planet]] [[Garel]]. One [[Standard day|day]] during the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Blood Sisters]]" to [[4 BBY]]. the sergeant was patrolling the [[Garel City Spaceport]] with a squad of stormtroopers when they encountered the [[Spectres|rebels]] [[Sabine Wren]], [[Ezra Bridger]], [[C1-10P]], and [[EG-86]] squaring off with the [[Black Sun]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Ketsu Onyo]]. The sergeant informed them that the hangar was closed and that they were to leave immediately. In response, Onyo fired her weapons at the stormtroopers. The Imperials opened fire on everyone present, prompting a [[Skirmish in the Garel City Spaceport|violent skirmish]]. Several stormtroopers were incapacitated during the firefight while the sergeant climbed atop some crates to get a better vantage point. With the help of C1-10P, the rebels were able to escape aboard a [[starship]] and left Onyo to face the remaining stormtroopers alone. The sergeant and his men surrounded Onyo and ordered her to surrender. The bounty hunter responded by grabbing a stormtrooper to use as a shield, which another stormtroopers shot in the chest as they tried to shoot Onyo. The bounty hunter used her [[Ketsu's staff|staff]] to melee her way past the remaining stormtroopers, and disarmed the sergeant in the process. He chased her, but she turned around and whacked him across the head with her staff. After jumping over the last conscious stormtrooper, Onyo escaped to her personal ship, the ''[[Shadow Caster]]''. The sergeant got back to his feet along with the another stormtrooper and, after watching Onyo leave the planet in her ship, the [[Stormtrooper Commander|commanding officer]] verbally expressed a distaste for the bounty hunters on Garel. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Bounty hunting scum. Garel's crawling with them.|The stormtrooper sergeant after the skirmish's conclusion|}} A male individual, the sergeant was serious when he ordered Onyo and the rebels to leave. When Onyo attacked, the sergeant responded by firing back and climbing nearby equipment to get a better shot at the insurgents when they took cover. After the skirmish ended, the sergeant shook off the ordeal as an annoyance. The sergeant held a low opinion of bounty hunters. ==Equipment== {{Quote|There's no escape! We have you surrounded.|The sergeant after cornering Ketsu Onyo|}} The sergeant wore [[Color|white]] [[stormtrooper armor]] along with a white [[pauldron]] to denote his [[Military rank|rank]] as a sergeant. He carried an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== The sergeant first appeared in "[[Blood Sisters]]," an episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. His voice was provided by [[Stephen Stanton]], credited as "Stormtrooper #1." Although his rank went unmentioned in the episode, the [[canon]] source book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' mentions that stormtroopers with white pauldrons are sergeants. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Blood Sisters}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/blood-sisters-episode-guide|text="Blood Sisters" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{Databank|ketsu-s-staff|Ketsu's Staff}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtrooper officers of the Galactic Empire]]
